issues: Factual error: TCP connection establishment is strictly a three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK). There is no fourth 'CONFIRM' packet in RFC 793 standard TCP.
corrected_text: TCP uses a three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) to reliably establish connections before exchanging data.

issues: Factual error: Reinforces the incorrect claim that TCP connection setup is a 4-step process and penalizes writing 3-way handshake.
corrected_text: In academic exams, TCP connection establishment must always be described as a three-way handshake consisting of SYN, SYN-ACK, and ACK.
